entity: Las Vegas Sands' Texas media/ad spending to push casino legislation, 2021-26
what_we_add: $20,575,810.66 across 62 monthly lobby reports filed by Andy Abboud, May 2021-Jun 2026; 70-71% of all Texas lobby media spending, 2.5x all other lobbyists combined ($8.26M); about 4x Sands' ~$5.1M federal lobby fees in the same months
why: Texas Tribune and Casino.org name Sands and report a multimillion-dollar Texas ad blitz, same direction as ours. None has the $20.58M lobby-report total, the Abboud filings or the share of all Texas lobby media. Tribune's 'at least $2M' ad figure covers the 2021 session only, so it can't be lined up against a 2021-26 total; not a contradiction.
